Using log(x**3) = 3*log(x):

∫ -3*log(x**3) dx = ∫ -3*3*log(x) dx = ∫ -9*log(x) dx

Since ∫ log(x) dx = x*log(x) - x:

= -9*(x*log(x) - x) + C
= -9*x*log(x) + 9*x + C

<answer>-9*x*log(x)+9*x+C</answer>
